lines.text: By the seventh month, Jeshua and Zerubbabel built the altar and sacrificed burnt offerings morning and evening, though they feared the people of the land.
They celebrated the Feast of Weeks and offered burnt offerings daily, though the temple foundation had not been laid.
They paid masons and carpenters and sent food, drink and oil to Sidon and Tyre for cedar logs brought by sea to Joppa.
In the second month of the second year, the work began, and Levites twenty years old or older were appointed as supervisors.
When the foundation was laid, priests with trumpets and Levites with harps praised the LORD, and the sound was heard from afar.
